name: source_ref
description: Where this record's wording or evidence comes from.

aiGuidance.purpose: Points a record back to the plan, file, issue or conversation that states it, so the record is an index not a second copy. Defined in the method package so it stays self-contained.
aiGuidance.extraction: One entry per source: repo-relative path with its repo, or an issue in repo#number form.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: Do not paste the source's text here.
